title: Bolt Drop
description: Unscrew colored bolts from stacked wooden planks into matching boxes, keep the 5-slot tray clear and drop every plank across five boards.
controls: Tap an uncovered screw to unscrew it. It flies to the open box of its color, otherwise to the tray. Three screws fill a box; five in the tray jams the board.

zh-CN.title: 螺丝落盒
zh-CN.description: 把叠在一起的木板上的彩色螺丝拧进同色盒子，别让 5 格托盘塞满，五块木板逐关变难。
zh-CN.controls: 点没被挡住的螺丝把它拧下：有同色盒子就飞进盒子，否则进托盘。3 颗装满一盒，托盘满 5 颗就失败。
